name: Souma Jace
source:
"Maybe this class really should be shut down after all... for everyone's sake."

- Affiliation: Pegasus Class
- Birthday: August 18
- Height: 168cm
- Likes: Oysters
- Dislikes: Herbs
- Will/Gem: [spoiler]"Six-way Flawless Flames of Calamity" Perfect Star Sapphire[/spoiler]

The protagonist, who is also a new student at the academy, he is secretly a spy working for the organization "Twilight Alliance". He's been sent there to investigate an item known as the "Philosopher's Stone", said to lie dormant within the academy.
Despite his exceptional intellect and second-place ranking on the entrance exam, he somehow ends up in the newly established "Pegasus Class" instead of the academy's highest-ranking "Diamond Class".

Following orders from "Master", he's forbidden from using his will, so he usually pretends to be powerless during his time at the academy.

[Translated from [url=https://cabbage-soft.com/products/jewelry/character/]Official Website[/url]]
